results.problem: Clique-based separator for intersection graphs of geodesic disks
results.previous_best: O(n^{2/3}) cliques for geodesic disks in a simple polygon [11]; open for polygons with holes
results.quote: Our result is actually much more general, as it shows that _for any well-behaved shortest-path metric d_ defined on a path-connected and closed subset \(F\subset\mathbb{R}^2\), a set of geodesic disks with respect to that metric admits a separator consisting of \(O(n^{3/4+\varepsilon})\) cliques.

results.problem: q-Coloring on intersection graphs of geodesic disks
results.quote: Then q-Coloring can be solved in \(2^{O(n^{\frac{3}{4}+\varepsilon})}\) time on \(\mathcal{G}^\times(\mathcal{D})\).

results.problem: Distance oracle for intersection graphs of geodesic disks
results.bound: O(n^{7/4+\varepsilon}) \text{ storage}, O(n^{3/4+\varepsilon}) \text{ query time}, \text{additive error } 1
results.quote: Our distance oracle uses \(O(n^{7/4+\varepsilon})\) storage and can report the hop distance between any two nodes in \(\mathcal{G}^\times(\mathcal{D})\) in \(O(n^{3/4+\varepsilon})\) time, up to an additive error of one.
